item.title: The whole of Albert Rd needs resurfacing, 4th August
item.description:
The whole of Albert Rd needs resurfacing, please, after all the building works you (GCC) have undertaken the past year at Pittville School. The surface is falling apart from the 1,000s of plant and materials movements. Some of the worst potholes have now fortunately been patched nearer to Pittville Circus roundabouts. Come the rain and frosts the whole road will disintegrate from all the cracking and pressure. Please, please, please can you tackle this sooner rather than later.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 82, Albert Road, Marle Hill, Cheltenham, Cheltenham
Report on FixMyStreet

item.description:
